In the figure, contour labels such as 200m and 300m can be seen; river L is located on the river channel slightly to the right in the figure, the upstream end of river L is near the side of the 300m contour line, and the downstream end connects leftward with a lower river channel. According to the 200m and 300m contour lines in the figure and their interval, it can be judged that the contour interval is 20m. Reasoning: Interpreting according to a contour interval of 20m, the high end of river L is in the 300—320m elevation belt, and the low end is in the 160—180m elevation belt. The question asks for the maximum possible value; usually the largest integer value less than 160m is taken, so it is 159m.
